name: Yonyou Network Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Yonyou Network Technology Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides digital software and services to enterprises and public organizations in China and internationally. The company operates YonBIP, a business innovation platform that offers cloud services; and Chanjet, which provides digital finance, taxation, and digital business cloud services, as well as provides community and customer support services.
